profile.headline: Software Engineer @ BNY
profile.summary: Hi! I'm Krishna, and I am currently a Software Engineer at BNY. I have 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer, focusing on Backend Development and DevOps. Feel free to connect and contact me!

positions.title: Percentage Project Committee-Data Analytics/Administrative Role
positions.description:
• Coordinate with other technology-related clubs and departments at Rutgers, distribute surveys to collect data, conduct the photoshoot, and perform administrative tasks as a data analytics/administrative team member in Percentage Project committee. The Percentage Project is a data driven social good campaign, which strives to educate on the challenges that women and underrepresented groups face in the technology field. 
•  Network with women and other minorities in computer science and tech-related fields by participating and attending various events and working on other side projects which aim to provide mentorship for women and other minorities in the technology field.

positions.title: Math/Business Tutor
positions.description:
•  Helped college-level students individually and in group sessions for Management, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Statistics and Calculus
•  Reinforced business and math skills by applying abstract concepts to real-world examples, using a hands-on approach to make sure students understood various concepts, and making practice problems for students to solve

positions.title: Camp Counselor/Stained Glass Instructor
positions.description:
•  Designed and led an 8-week curriculum plan as a Stained Glass Instructor, including planning activities, researching and ordering materials, doing inventory, and coordinating an art showcase in collaboration with other art programs and the Art Director 
•  Collaborated with head counselors in order to manage scheduling and taking care of a large group of kids

volunteerExperiences.description:
•  Provided office assistance as an administrative volunteer by assisting with data entry, making newsletters, and being in charge of mentoring newcomers
•  Gained insight into the healthcare service business and healthcare administration by interacting with various members of the staff and getting a tour of the healthcare administration facility. Learned about the roles of the various business leaders in the company and saw the day-to-day work for members in the business, HR, and computer science positions

•  Volunteered at various places including Mercer Street Friends Food Bank which focused on helping out with food distribution and El Centro de Recursos Para Familias which was to teach ESL
•  Tutored elementary school students as a part of an after-school program called Academic Sports Academy in the Trenton area, which included teaching literacy and academic skills and serving as a mentor for them

projects.title: Estee Lauder Hackathon
projects.description: Pink Lemonade is a website where users can find healthy recipes as well as connect with others through a social media network and find experts to talk about their diet and health with. Through this, we learned about the importance of diet and health in a survivor’s journey and just about the importance of taking care of one’s well-being. In addition, we learned more about how the Spoontacular API works and the various ways that recipes can be parsed through this. We decided to build the front-end part of a website where we display the results when a user inputs an ingredient or a food item into the search bar. Additionally, we created mock ups which show what we want the website to look like now and in the future.
